[process narration moved out of reading 2026-09-02] An earlier pass on file for this Collin County, Texas (Allen) record attempted to fetch a Cisco facilities and locations page and found it returned a not found error, so no address was confirmed and the row was left as not published. This session resolved the address. Reverse geocoding this rows own stored coordinates through a third party service returned 2260 Chelsea Blvd, Allen, TX 75013 at 1.0 confidence, and a dedicated, name specific listing for this exact facility on a data center industry aggregator independently gives the identical address, additionally identifying the site by the short code TXDC2, built in 2010, operational with future phases planned, and describing its infrastructure as using flywheel driven rotary UPS units on a solid floor design. Specific square footage and power capacity figures remain behind that aggregators paywall and are not asserted here. Given this convergence of an independent coordinate based method and a name specific aggregator listing with an exact address match, this session applies 2260 Chelsea Blvd as this rows address.

reading.body:
Cisco Allen is a data center campus in Allen, Texas, built in 2010, located at 2260 Chelsea Blvd. The facility's published power capacity and floor area are not available. The operator's specifications do not disclose whether this campus serves AI workloads or any other specific tenant category.

Texas has 133 mapped data center facilities, of which 18 publish power specifications totaling 468 megawatts. Cisco Allen does not appear in the published capacity rankings for the state, placing it outside the top 18 facilities by disclosed power. The state context provided does not include this campus's megawatt figure.

This campus cannot be assessed for relevance to AI scaling without published specifications on power capacity, IT load density, or cooling infrastructure. Cisco maintains a large networking equipment business separate from its data center operations. Whether this facility operates as a merchant colocation site, hosts company infrastructure, or serves other purposes is not disclosed.
